// std.viz · unit-aware plots: axes are labelled with the units the data carries.
import std.viz

fn main() -> Void {
    times = linspace(0.0, 40.0, 9) as s
    speeds = array([0.0, 6.1, 11.4, 15.8, 19.4, 22.3, 24.5, 26.1, 27.2]) as m/s
    // Converting the data converts the axis: the chart is in km/h.
    in_kmh = speeds as km/h
    distance = (speeds * (5 s)).cumsum()
    print("top speed " + in_kmh.max().to_string() + ", distance " + (distance.max() as km).to_string())
    fig = viz.figure("Car acceleration")
        .describe("the axis units come from the quantities")
        .labels("time", "speed")
        .unit_line(times, in_kmh, label: "measured")
        .unit_scatter(times, in_kmh)
    print(fig.svg())
}
